survey: A grey sci-fi control console stands on a floor of riveted metal tiles. The camera is a little above the console and to its right, so we see the front face, a narrow strip of the right side and the sloped control panel on top. The front face is a flat box with an inset drawer and a grey handle. Its top and bottom edges slope gently down to the right and its vertical edges stay vertical. The right side face gets shorter as it goes back, and its bottom edge rises toward a vanishing point on the right. A raised rail runs along the back of the sloped panel, and its right end shows the same side view. The sloped panel tilts toward the viewer. On it are a large white gauge and a smaller green gauge, both drawn as ellipses flattened about the right amount for the slope. There are also two staggered rows of red and yellow round buttons, each an ellipse with a matching ring around it. The rows slope down to the right, following the panel's front edge. On the right of the panel, a dark rectangular block with a slot sits flat on the slope, and a lever rises from it straight up, topped with a red ball. The drawer handle shows a little of its top surface, which matches the raised camera. The box rests flat on the floor. The floor seams near the front run parallel to the box's bottom front edge, and the seams on the right run parallel to the side face, so the floor and the object share one viewpoint.
